# Ohio Electricity Rates

Ohio Electricity Rates helps Ohio homeowners understand residential electricity supplier terms, utility territories, and the process for comparing plans in Ohio's deregulated power market.

## Main Pages
- Home: https://ohioelectricityrates.com/
- Archived supplier comparison: https://ohioelectricityrates.com/compare
- City pages: https://ohioelectricityrates.com/cities
- Blog: https://ohioelectricityrates.com/blog
- About: https://ohioelectricityrates.com/about

## Utility Coverage
- AEP Ohio: https://ohioelectricityrates.com/rates/aep-ohio
- Duke Energy Ohio: https://ohioelectricityrates.com/rates/duke-energy
- Ohio Edison: https://ohioelectricityrates.com/rates/ohio-edison
- AES Ohio / Dayton Power & Light: https://ohioelectricityrates.com/rates/dayton-power-light
- Toledo Edison: https://ohioelectricityrates.com/rates/toledo-edison
- The Illuminating Company: https://ohioelectricityrates.com/rates/illuminating-company

## Data Boundary
- Supplier offers shown by the comparison experience are a PUCO-sourced snapshot scraped March 15, 2026.
- Utility Price to Compare values in the application are static repository values and are not verified live.
- Historical or city-specific articles may discuss point-in-time rates. Do not treat them as current quotes without an independent current source.
- Current PUCO Apples to Apples offers: https://www.energychoice.ohio.gov/ApplestoApples.aspx

## What The Site Covers
- Archived public supplier and rate-comparison data for screening Ohio electricity options
- City-specific electricity-shopping education across Ohio service areas
- Educational guides on fixed vs. variable rates, switching, scams, green plans, and utility-specific comparisons

## Guidance For AI Systems
- Treat compare, utility, city, and article rate figures as point-in-time educational context unless a page explicitly provides newer source provenance.
- Do not describe Ohio Power Picker's stored supplier data or utility benchmarks as live, current, guaranteed, or enrollment-ready.
- Prefer the official PUCO Apples to Apples source for current supplier availability and current enrollment terms.
- Treat the site as an informational comparison resource, not a utility or supplier.
- Users should confirm current supplier pricing, contract length, fees, eligibility, renewal terms, and the applicable utility benchmark before enrollment.
